summary.text: Fred Girod is a Republican member of the Oregon State Senate for District 9, which his legislative page associates with Stayton.
A dentist by occupation, he was appointed to the Senate in 2008 after being elected to the Oregon House.

paragraphs.text: Girod's biography lists his occupation as dentist, with more than 30 years of practice, along with real estate development.

He graduated from Stayton High School, received a B.S. from Oregon State University and a D.M.D. from Oregon Health Sciences University, and earned a master's in public administration from Harvard University.
His listed prior governmental experience includes election to the Oregon House of Representatives in November 1992 and 2006, and appointment to the Oregon State Senate in 2008.
He has also served on the Stayton City Council and the Stayton Budget Committee and the page lists service as chair of a Rules Committee.
